users.description: Céramiste et fondatrice de l'Atelier Lumière. Formée à Saint-Quentin-la-Poterie, Émilie tourne le grès depuis quinze ans et anime les stages intensifs.
Responsable de l'émaillage et des cuissons. Claire anime le cours du jeudi soir et teste chaque semaine de nouvelles recettes d'émaux.
Passionné de raku et de modelage, Lucas encadre les ateliers enfants du mercredi et les cuissons raku du samedi.

menu_locations.note: Twenty Twenty-Five (block theme) registers no classic menu locations, so no menu is assigned to a location. Its header Navigation block uses the wp_navigation post derived from "Menu principal".

excluded.note: export_wp() skips spam comments (comment_approved <> "spam") and auto-drafts. Drafts, scheduled, private and password-protected posts ARE exported. Revisions are not exported (none exist anyway). Options/settings, theme mods, users without posts and application passwords are never part of WXR.

quirks: WordPress 7.1 also emits every category, tag, nav_menu and post_format term as a generic <wp:term> (get_terms() is called with an empty custom-taxonomy list), so categories/tags appear twice (as <wp:category>/<wp:tag> and as <wp:term>) - dedupe on term_id + taxonomy.
nav_menu terms are emitted twice as <wp:term> (generic loop + wxr_nav_menu_terms()).

Attachments: <wp:attachment_url> is wp_get_attachment_url(), i.e. the "-scaled" file for the 3000x2000 panorama; <guid> keeps the original upload URL; _wp_attachment_metadata (serialized) lists original_image and all sub-sizes.
_oembed_<md5> postmeta ({{unknown}}) and _wp_old_slug, _thumbnail_id, _wp_page_template, _menu_item_* are exported as plain postmeta.
The <pubDate> and the "created" generator comment change on every export; everything else is deterministic.

rest.auth: HTTP Basic with the application password: curl -u "admin:Fixt Atel Lumi 2026 Rest ApiK" ...

password_protected_public_view.note: Pass ?password=celadon2026 to get the rendered content.

notes: SEO (Yoast/Rank Math) and Elementor postmeta are NOT exposed by the REST API (protected "_" keys / unregistered meta, plugins not installed: no yoast_head / yoast_head_json either). Get them from the WXR, or register them yourself.
The only registered post meta is "footnotes" (core), so meta = {"footnotes": ""}.
Embeds render as plain links in content.rendered (oEmbed lookups are blocked); use content.raw (context=edit) for block markup.
/wp/v2/comments lists only type=comment by default; pingbacks need ?type=pingback.
Public /wp/v2/users only lists users with published posts.

Anonymous GET /wp/v2/blocks answers [] while X-WP-Total says 1 (core: the published wp_block is counted, then filtered out by the per-item read permission check). Authenticated, it returns the pattern.
Published wp_navigation posts are readable anonymously (/wp/v2/navigation).
Private posts: anonymous visitors get plain ?p=ID permalinks; authenticated users get the pretty URL (core wp_force_plain_post_permalink()). Drafts and scheduled posts always have ?p=ID links.
